'''Risol''' was an independent [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Risol had heavily modified an [[LE-series repair droid]] to serve as a scheduler, bookkeeper, and repairman.
